enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Constitution +13: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Wisdom +13: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Incite +52: +52% Insight bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Insightful Intimidate +10: Passive: +10 Insight bonus to the Intimidate skill.
Linguistics: This item reduced the cooldowns of your Social skills (Diplomacy, Bluff, Intimidate) by 10%. This does not stack with the Negotiator ability.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
